messages:
Ava (CS): FYI Pri from NovaTech AP said they won't accept the DocuSign envelope; their ERP needs a two-line invoice split and the billing entity must be the subsidiary 'NovaTech Pharma Ltd'.
Diego (AM): Which envelope ID?
Ava (CS): envelope id: ffa1b2c3-77d7-4ee2. They also asked for vendor code NOV-PH-22.
Pri (Customer Finance): Confirmed. AP requires: 1) NovaTech US (EIN 98-7654321) invoice $65,000; 2) NovaTech Pharma Ltd (VAT NL123456789) invoice 35,000. They want a one-page approval PDF with that breakdown to attach to the PO.
Sofia (Ops): Can do. Do we accept a scanned wet-signature?
Marta (Legal): For totals under $150k, yes as exception if uploaded to Box with audit note. Add clause: "This approval is for procurement routing only and not an amendment." Include signer name/title/email and PO line.
Sofia (Ops): Drafted stub PDF and uploaded to Box: /Approvals/novatech/1789994322-stub.pdf. DocSend: https://docsend.com/view/novatech-stub-1789994322
Ava (CS): Sent to Pri; offering options: corrected DocuSign, emailed PDF stub, or wet-signed scan. Pri prefers emailed PDF.
Pri (Customer Finance): Emailed to ap@novatech.com. AP accepted and attached to PO. Will update with PO number. :thumbsup:
DocuSign Bot: Alert  envelope ffa1b2c3 metadata mismatch: billing_entity == "NovaTech Group". Recommend update.
Sofia (Ops): Created ticket OPS-8009 to fix envelope entity mapping.
Diego (AM): Thanks team, keeping this on my renewal tracker. Close after PO lands.
